messages:
anya: heads-up — spike of fncall validation rejects in ap-south. many are union fields where model returns empty string instead of null. validator marks as hard reject and we route to degen, inflating reject metrics. sample below.

	sam: raw log snippet:```json
{"req":"r777","task":"extract","result":""}
```


	leo: this is annoying for customers — app often works with coerced null. can we soft-coerce empty-string->null for nullable unions? keep hard reject for bad-json/timeouts.

	anya: proposed: add soft-validate mode that applies small coercions (empty->null, small numeric strings->number). soft-mode emits `validation_mode=soft` and `validation_detail=nullable-empty-string`. do not route to degen on soft accept; instead attach warning in response envelope and surface in console. rollout behind FF 5%->25%->100%.

	sam: telemetry: add `fncall.validation_mode`, `fncall.validation_detail`, `fncall.route_final`, and `billing_impact` tag. sample some full outputs (1/100) for audit.

	leo: ops: add SLO exception so soft-validates don't page. keep existing pager for hard rejects.

	devops-bot: scheduled canary deploy ap-south 2026-03-24T07:00:00Z. FF `fncall.soft_validation_v1` = 5% enabled. Sampling 1/100.

	anya: action items: (1) implement validator coercions + routing change (anya/sam), (2) telemetry fields + sampling (sam), (3) runbook/SLO tweak (leo), (4) console note for canary (product). will open PRs and link here.
